week.title: Set up (about 1 hour)
tasks: Double-click AGENCY_DAY.bat: Notepad opens agency/config.json; put in your name, phone, email, postal address, city; save
Make the free accounts: Netlify, Stripe, Payhip, Fiverr (real name, finish the ID check)
Double-click AGENCY_DAY.bat again: 3 demo sites, the call list and TODAY.txt

week.title: First calls (1 hour)
tasks: Drop the 3 site folders on app.netlify.com/drop, press Publish
Call 10 owners from Call today, by hand, 10:00-12:00 or 14:00-16:00
Mark every call on the card (Contacted, Call back, Do not contact)

week.title: Shop + gigs (1 hour)
tasks: Payhip: upload the 5 products with docs/BUSINESS_LISTING_KIT.md (zips: RUN_MONEY or python -m money_machines.products.build_all --zip)
Fiverr: publish the logo and Google-profile gigs (docs/GIG_PACK.md)
Make one Stripe payment link per plan, paste them in the billing kit

week.title: Calls + Instagram (1 hour)
tasks: AGENCY_DAY.bat, then 10 more calls
New Instagram (Professional); schedule the first week in Meta Business Suite
Put the shop link in the bio

week.title: Follow up (1 hour)
tasks: Call back everyone who asked; send the demo link only to those who said send it
10 new calls
Answer every Fiverr message the same day

week.title: Close (1 hour)
tasks: A yes: python -m agency.billing kit for their proposal + invoice with your payment link
Tell Claude 'Agency: <business> said yes' to build the live site
10 calls

week.title: Count (15 min)
tasks: Agency page > Export; count calls, talks, demos, yeses
Business page: what moved, what to drop
Tell Claude your counts: it replaces the guessed call rates with yours

rules: Nothing here sends, posts or calls: you press every button.
Calls by hand, business hours, never a robot or a recording; stop means Do not contact.
Emails need your real name, email and postal address (CAN-SPAM).
Every $ is an ESTIMATE range from the teams' docs, not a promise; 'real' is only what the ledger recorded.
